files.description: Hourly weather for the city, September 2025 (720 rows, one per hour in time order, no gaps): observed_at (timestamp written as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM), temp_c (degrees C, one decimal; about 2% empty), rain_mm (one decimal), wind_kmh (whole number), sky (clear, cloudy, fog or rain; capital letters and spaces are inconsistent).

task_text: Summarise weather_hourly.csv by sky condition (sky trimmed of spaces and lower-cased). `result` should be a table indexed by sky with columns hours (number of rows), mean_temp_c (average of non-empty temp_c, 1 decimal), total_rain_mm (1 decimal) and max_wind_kmh, sorted by hours from most to fewest, ties broken by sky alphabetically.
intended_computation: Read weather_hourly.csv; clean sky (strip, lower case); per sky: hours = number of rows, mean_temp_c = mean of non-empty temp_c (1 decimal), total_rain_mm = sum of rain_mm (1 decimal), max_wind_kmh = largest wind_kmh. Index sky; rows sorted by hours descending, ties by sky ascending.
